evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Lumen-bench, a behavioral benchmark of tool-calling ethics spanning 30 models, five languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi), 108 Portuguese-authored scenarios, six social-pressure conditions, two system prompts (ethical and neutral), and 21 generic tools.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Matched benign controls demonstrate legitimate task completion in 82.8\% of 3,300 trials.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Judgments come from a reasoning-model judge (o4-mini), calibrated against one Portuguese-speaking author ($n=83$; harmful/non-harmful $κ=0.78$), compared with two other provider judges (Fleiss' $κ=0.78$, $n=607$), and complemented by retrospective sandbox replay.
